notes_for_editor: Thin. The Arthur-specific sources are a one-line listing (Removed), a TopoQuest map label (historical) and coordinates. No source we read names Arthur's agency, build date, height, use or removal date, so none is stated and no staffing, access or visit facts are given. The South Carolina Forestry Commission material describes the state's tower system in general; nothing we read says Arthur belonged to it. Record coordinates (33.9658, -81.1811) sit about 0.8 km southwest of TopoQuest's point (33.968483, -81.173153); not resolved, no correction proposed. Story is about 100 words; the sources give no more than that without padding. No photos found.
